To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

there is a significant heterogeneity in performance of workflows for differential expression detection, that the choice of differential expression detection tool has the greatest influence on performance, that there is a trade-off in the performance of workflows in that some are better at precision and some are better at recall, and that our results can serve as a resource for future developments of software for RNA-seq analyses.

the performance of RNA-seq differential expression analysis workflows varies widely depending on the choice of software, and that the choice of workflow can impact both the number and identity of genes called differentially expressed, as well as precision and recall.

there is significant heterogeneity among RNA-Seq workflows in their ability to detect differentially expressed genes, and that different workflows exhibit a bias toward higher precision or recall, which should be taken into account in choosing a workflow for a particular analysis.

the question of what are the best tools for RNA-Seq data analysis and what is the impact of the choice of tools on the results.

the choice of RNA-Seq workflow can have a significant impact on the number of genes that are called differentially expressed, and on the precision and recall of the resulting list of genes.
